basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) on its official website for the recruitment of 1 Research Associate-I post under Advertisement No. SPON/7041/Adv0283 DATED 22.07.2026. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking a contractual research position in Gujarat.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Nanotechnology, or closely related discipline
qualification.details: Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Nanotechnology, or a closely related discipline. Candidates who have submitted their thesis are also eligible. The percentage with respect to the academic qualifications will be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onward and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-07-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Gandhinagar is 30th July 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Nanotechnology, or a closely related discipline. Thesis submission is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without any financial obligation for the application itself.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 54,200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Gandhinagar through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate-I recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out and submit their applications through the official portal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Associate-I at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual job, meaning the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates who have submitted their thesis eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their thesis for their Ph.D. are also eligible to apply for the Research Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPON/7041/Adv0283 DATED 22.07.2026.
